name: Auto Deco
description: Decorates the whole level in the editor with one tap: places decoration objects along the exposed edges of your solid blocks.

palette.name: Decoration palette
palette.description: Built-in decoration set to use: Bushes, Grass, Dots or Mixed. "My IDs" uses the IDs below (or the decoration already in your level if that is empty). The IDs come from a community object list and are not tested in game.

deco-ids.name: Decoration object IDs
deco-ids.description: Object IDs to use, separated by commas (for example 1888, 1889). The "Learn Style" button in the editor pause menu fills this for you from the objects you have selected. If left empty, the mod uses the decoration objects that already exist in your level.

density.name: Density (%)
density.description: Chance that each row of free block edges gets decorated. Higher = more rows decorated.

max-objects.name: Max new objects
max-objects.description: Safety limit so a big level does not get thousands of objects and lag.

top-only.name: Top edges only
top-only.description: Only decorate the tops of blocks (not sides or bottoms).

spacing.name: Spacing
spacing.description: Distance between decorations in a row, in blocks. 1 = one on every block, 2 = every other block.

color-channel.name: Color channel
color-channel.description: Gives every decoration this color channel (1-999) so you can recolor them all at once, for example purple, by editing that channel in the editor colors menu. 0 = do not change.
